record.question: Which unit in total station processes data collected?
record.explanation: The total station’s internal microprocessor performs mathematical operations on the measured angles/distances, including coordinate calculations and corrections. A data collector primarily records/stores observations in this instrument-component distinction. Reference: https://archive.nptel.ac.in/content/storage2/courses/105104100/lectureA_3/A_3_3_TS.htm. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
